Parent/closure ticket for the film compiler. Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md (answers the ten carried questions, which are retained there). Owner decision 2026-09-22: P1a adopted (bd-01M2TA1P0GXBHRF24W0VE7B66D) -- this is 1.1 work (container bd-01M35MK5N6F0EWJE2EYT3D8Y9M), not on the 1.0 path; F0 (2026-09-21) selected claim-status alternative A.
Children: F1 bd-01M2YY2YJWXT406AZ3W4K9935W, F2 bd-01M2YY37377TYWWKQM6AZJSBQ0, F3 bd-01M2YY3FK1F5MJEMQX36NTXHNP, F4 bd-01M2YY3R25N9XWWAC4EZ3X3BJ9, F5 bd-01M2YY40FSG20HFF30S6RVVDQ5, F6 bd-01M2YY490C0BAPDT6VRTEZ5DTF. F6 blocks this ticket.
Close when: F1-F6 are closed with their own evidence; NarrativeCompiler.compileFilm exists as an additive public API (text compile/NarrativeCompilation/TextModel byte-identical, S0 pins unchanged); api-stability.md lists the new film compiler types. Not in scope: D1B end-to-end alignment proofs (bd-01M1CQNM5DZZNWD8BN4WRKVZRQ), V1, E0, any accuracy claim.
Sequencing: after the MVP mapping journey (G2 facade/exchange and [Workflow] intake/CLI). It does not gate M1 or the annotation-assisted preview.
